clues.text: After the golden calf, Moses called at the camp entrance for those on the LORD's side, and these men all gathered around him.
In the wilderness, the LORD took these men for Himself in place of every firstborn son of Israel.
Whenever Israel's camp moved in the wilderness, these men took down the tabernacle and set it up again.
They received no land among Israel's tribes; the LORD gave them Israel's tithes as their inheritance instead.
When Israel settled the land, these men were given forty-eight cities to live in, with pasturelands around them.
King David declared that no one but these men could carry the ark of God, since the LORD chose them.
Leaders from Jerusalem sent priests and these men to John the Baptist to ask him, "Who are you?"
